title: #LenovoBootManager.v1_0_0.LenovoBootManager

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

@odata.id.description: This property shall be used to represent the 'Next One-Time Boot' setting in F1 console and the other settings of the BootOrder config in the UCM xml file sent by uEFI.
@odata.id.longDescription: Normally the value should be 'Next One-Time Boot', and the setting names under BootOrder config in xml, like 'BootOrder' and 'WolBootOrder'.

BootOrderNext.description: List the value of boot order. They are in pending state
BootOrderNext.longDescription: Based on the 'BootOrderCurrent', user can modify and adjust the order of the elements. The boot order takes effect on the next startup.

BootOrderCurrent.description: List the value of boot order'. They are current configuration.
BootOrderCurrent.longDescription: List the current boot order settings. And the element in array is with the order.

BootOrderSupported.description: List the value of supported boot order
BootOrderSupported.longDescription: List all the supported boot source for the specific name.

LenovoBootManager.description: This schema defines a resource for user to select the boot source when the manager is powered on
LenovoBootManager.longDescription: This resource shall be used to represent resources that can control the manager boot.
